mapper.select: SELECT cust_no AS customer_id, cust_nm AS customer_name, mbl_telno AS mobile_phone_number, email_addr AS email, CASE WHEN brdt IS NULL OR btrim(brdt) = '' THEN NULL WHEN btrim(brdt) ~ '^[0-9]{8}$' AND to_char(to_date(btrim(brdt), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD') = btrim(brdt) THEN to_char(to_date(btrim(brdt), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE NULL END AS birth_date, CASE upper(btrim(sex_cd)) WHEN '1' THEN 'MALE' WHEN 'M' THEN 'MALE' WHEN '2' THEN 'FEMALE' WHEN 'F' THEN 'FEMALE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS gender, rdnm_addr AS road_address, CASE WHEN reg_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' END AS registered_at, CASE WHEN mdfcn_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' END AS modified_at, COALESCE(upper(btrim(use_yn)) = 'Y', FALSE) AS active, 'LEGACY_CUST' AS source_system, 'CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT' AS event_type, to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' AS extracted_at FROM src_cust ORDER BY cust_no
